audience.text: C++ developers building desktop or server applications that need to generate or process Excel .xlsx files without external runtime dependencies or licensing costs.

capabilities.text: Construct blank workbooks or load existing ones from file paths or in-memory streams, then save back to .xlsx format using Workbook.Save().
capabilities.title: Create and save .xlsx workbooks

capabilities.text: Set and retrieve cell values of multiple types including strings, numbers, booleans, and DateTime, and manage Excel formulas via Cell.PutValue() and Cell.SetFormula().
capabilities.title: Read and write cell values and formulas

capabilities.text: Modify font properties, fill patterns, border styles, alignment, and number formats using Style, Font, Borders, and Color objects.
capabilities.title: Apply cell and range styling

capabilities.text: Control visibility, zoom, gridlines, headers, right-to-left layout, and protection settings per worksheet.
capabilities.title: Manage worksheet structure and view

capabilities.text: Define rule-based formatting and input constraints on cell ranges using FormatCondition and Validation objects.
capabilities.title: Apply conditional formatting and data validation

capabilities.text: Set paper size, orientation, margins, print area, headers/footers, and page breaks via PageSetup.
capabilities.title: Configure page setup and print options

capabilities.text: Attach hyperlinks to cell ranges and define workbook- or sheet-scoped named ranges with optional comments.
capabilities.title: Manage hyperlinks and defined names

limitations.text: Only .xlsx (OOXML) format is supported for loading and saving; saving to other formats throws UnsupportedFeatureException.
Legacy SpreadsheetML (Excel 2003 XML) is not implemented; mapper classes for it unconditionally throw UnsupportedFeatureException.
Cell-level comments/notes are not modeled as a distinct object; only DefinedName has a Comment field.
Some advanced conditional-formatting rule types are dropped with a WarningInfo during load rather than preserved.
AutoFilter date-group filters using certain patterns are rejected as unsupported during load.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic Excel workbook creation and manipulation in C++ without requiring Microsoft Excel or external runtime dependencies.
Provides a familiar API surface compatible with Aspose.Cells commercial products for teams migrating from or extending existing workflows.
Supports common spreadsheet tasks such as cell value/formula handling, styling, conditional formatting, data validation, and page setup via a single, self-contained library.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Cells FOSS for C++ is a dependency-free, header-and-source C++17 library for creating, loading, editing, and saving Excel .xlsx workbooks without requiring Microsoft Excel.

uncertainties: The exact set of supported conditional-formatting rule types that are dropped with WarningInfo is not specified beyond 'some advanced' types.
The precise patterns for AutoFilter date-group filters that are rejected are not detailed.
Whether the library supports reading or writing .xlsb, .ods, or .csv formats is not confirmed beyond explicit .xlsx-only support.
The behavior when loading corrupted or partially malformed .xlsx files beyond InvalidFileFormatException is not detailed.
Whether the library supports embedded charts, pivot tables, or macros is not stated.
The extent of locale-specific number formatting support beyond DisplayTextFormatter is not clarified.
The behavior of Workbook.Save() when the target path is unwritable is not specified.
Whether the library supports saving to streams other than std::vector<uint8_t> is not stated.

workflows.name: Create and style an Excel workbook
workflows.text: Construct a Workbook, access its first Worksheet, populate cells with values and formulas, apply header styling using Style and Font, and save to an .xlsx file.

workflows.name: Load and inspect an existing workbook
workflows.text: Load a workbook from a file path or in-memory stream, iterate over worksheets and cells, read values and formulas, and access document properties.

workflows.name: Apply conditional formatting and validation
workflows.text: Add conditional formatting rules and data validation constraints to cell ranges using ConditionalFormattingCollection and ValidationCollection.

workflows.name: Configure print and page settings
workflows.text: Set paper size, orientation, margins, print area, headers/footers, and page breaks via PageSetup on a worksheet.
